question: In a Two-Headed Giant game, does dethrone trigger when the creature attacks either player on the team with the most life?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: it triggers if the creature attacks either player on the team with the most life or tied for the most life.
expected.answer: In a Two-Headed Giant game, dethrone will trigger if the creature attacks either player on the team with the most life or tied for the most life.

whyHard: Life is shared in Two-Headed Giant but attacks are still against one player, so players are unsure which life total counts.
